about: Sources of the dissertation citation graph, read in this order by scripts/dissertation_ingest.py. Paths: absolute, 'data/...' from the repository root, or bare names inside this directory. Globs allowed. 'ingest': false = read and report only. 'verify_existing': the adapter must reproduce the existing manifest entries exactly (reported as present_identical).

sources.name: canada_user_run
sources.about: Canadian History PhDs from the user-run wget lists of scripts/user_run_canada.py (2026-11-14), registered from the repository listing metadata by scripts/register_canada_user_run.py after whole-file and title-page validation. Files registered by AHA title page live in us-dissertations-expansion-2026-10-20/manual-aha-2026-11-04 and are excluded here.

sources.name: us_expansion
sources.about: The user's ChatGPT US collection; collection-manifest*.csv is regenerated by scripts/audit_us_dissertation_collection.py after each round.

sources.name: us_browser
sources.about: Browser-collected US PDFs; spec in data/field-research/us-dissertations-browser-handoff-2026-10-20/README.md. Absent until the first delivery.

sources.name: japan
sources.about: Not ingested until the extractor reads Japanese bibliography headings (参考文献, 文献目録, 引用文献).

sources.name: base
sources.about: BASE theses worldwide. Only history_label 'history' clusters with a completed download (user decision 2026-10-20: 'history' only for now). Ingested from 2026-10-20 after the extractor gained German, Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish, Italian, Dutch, Catalan and Greek headings.

country_overrides.about: BASE files these repositories under 'United States'; they are KIT Karlsruhe (DE) and Universidad Torcuato Di Tella, Buenos Aires (AR). Checked 2026-10-20.

sources.name: uk_openaire
sources.about: UK doctorates from the OpenAIRE/UK-repository collector (another session; still collecting). Verified UK doctorates by the collector's rule; History screened by scripts/uk_dissertation_scope.py (department, LC class with historical title, Edinburgh school title screen, OpenAIRE title screen). Records outside the screen stay needs_review. User, 2026-10-28: 'We now have 3276 UK doctorates; a few might be archeology or other related disciplines; I think we can rebuild the graph; Edinburgh is still downloading, but we can catch them after the next major update.'

sources.name: oxford_ora
sources.about: Oxford DPhil theses in History departments found through DataCite (10.5287) supervisor seeds and a history-like title/subject screen, checked on ORA landing pages; open PDFs only. User, 2026-10-29: 'yes, we need more oxford coverage'.

sources.name: france_thesesfr
sources.about: French History doctorates (discipline screen) from the ABES open-data export with online access, fetched via theses.fr. User, 2026-10-30: 'we can then target more French dissertations to get them to 2000'.

sources.name: brazil_capes
sources.about: Brazilian History doctorates: CAPES national catalogue (DOUTORADO, area HISTÓRIA) as the History screen; PDFs from university repositories (OAI, UFF programme site, USP item pages), author-authorized files on legacy Sucupira, and browser downloads. User, 2026-10-31/11-01: add Brazil ('start the catalog'; 'Scan + download'). Ingested from 2026-11-02 (user: 'continue work', after the parsing review).

sources.name: mexico_records
sources.about: Mexican History doctorates: TesiUNAM (OAI; 'Título otorgado: Doctorado en Historia', all open access), Instituto Mora, El Colegio de Michoacán (Centro de Estudios Históricos), El Colegio de San Luis and Ibero (DSpace OAI), each kept only when the title page names the History doctorate (scripts/register_mexico_theses.py). El Colegio de México's PDFs sit behind a captcha for scripts and are not included. User, 2026-11-04: 'start mexico'; 'stick with history for now'.

sources.name: dnb_germany
sources.about: German-language History doctorates from the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek catalogue (CC0 metadata, degree years 2000-2027; scripts/dnb_german_theses_table.py) with the open PDFs of scripts/german_theses_fetch.py and the user's browser downloads registered by scripts/german_theses_register.py (manifest on E:, status 'downloaded'). History: DNB subject group 940/943 ('high') or another 9xx group ('medium'), or a 'low' row title-screened 'history'; economic and social history, history of science, technology and medicine count. Held out until the user rules: ancient history and archaeology (DNB group 930, or ancient Rome/Greece/Near East/Qin-Han in the screen), Egyptology/Assyriology, church history. Rows that duplicate another (duplicate_of) or are already held (held_id) are left out. User ruling 2026-11-16: history of science and history of education count as History (screen-overrides-2026-11-16.csv). Country: the degree place (DE, AT, CH; others by city). Thesis authors are seeds only: no person keys from this source until the user approves a proposal.
